text:
I finished my first half marathon in Bengaluru in 2:05:30.

The biggest lesson from training: consistency beat motivation. Motivation came and went. Showing up on the days I didn't feel like running is what carried me to the finish line.

Huge thanks to my running group, Sunday Striders, for the encouragement and the miles we shared along the way.

#HalfMarathon #Running #Bengaluru
